title: 2013 Honda Pilot Dent Repair and Fender Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair replaced the driver-side fender and refinished four door moldings on a 2013 Honda Pilot.
story: This 2013 Honda Pilot arrived at Carcis Autobody Repair requiring bodywork along the driver side. Damaged components included the driver-side front fender and all four side door moldings, which showed scraping and surface damage.

The repair plan called for replacing the driver-side fender entirely. Auto body technicians prepped the new fender panel, leveling the surface with filler and primer where needed. Meanwhile, technicians sanded and prepped the side door moldings across both doors to remove deep scratches and prepare the trim surfaces for repainting.

Once prepped, the replacement fender and all four door moldings were painted in matching maroon lacquer and clear coat. After curing, final polishing returned a smooth, uniform finish across the entire side profile of the crossover.
